subject: Scheduled report: {dashboardTitle}
preheader: Your scheduled {productName} dashboard report is attached as a PDF.
body:
The scheduled report "{dashboardTitle}" from {productName} is attached to this email as a PDF.

The numbers were generated at send time; open the dashboard online for the live view.
footer: You are receiving this because a {productName} user scheduled this dashboard report for you. Contact them to change or stop these emails.
